full_text:
Interesting thread... if i may i'll add some stream of thoughts on programming of consciousness an how to tap into it through question and choice tools.

A few snippets of thought:

> Why are we [you] here? 
I am here to steward through new paradigms of consciousness on this planet. 

**Choice creates**
We have choice, we can choose to be the master meta-programmers of our consciousness. We can alter the functioning of our state, we can upgrade the runtimes of awareness, so that we have all of the faculties available to us, the full spectrum of choices and the capacity to create and actualise into existence what we choose. What would be possible then? What capacities do we have available are we not acknowedging, that if we did, could alter existence entirely?

Or, we can choose to be the slave to the master, the beast that is ruled by something outside and above us, like a group of horses being ridden by its rider. Do I want to be the rider that can steer and navigate or do I want to be the horses steered by something other? 

**The need to be right is the destruction of freedom**
Question for anyone reading? Have you ever got into a state, where you prefer to be right than understanding where the other person is? This is a typical way of functioning, we rather be right than aware. Everywhere I choose to be right than be aware will I now uncreate from my programming, and make space for awareness? Yes, ok (i need to run that process about 100 times a day). The need to be right creates separation between parties. It implies wrongness: wrongness of the other, or wrongness of ourselves if we do not prove to ourselves we are right. Better be free than be right? Free to have the full spectrum of human consciousness, of choices. What vital need to be right is blocking us from the freedom of being?

Rightness is a judgement, which collapses consciousness into a polarity, right and wrong. The choice to find whats right and wrong, about yourself or others, limits are functionality, cuts off our ability to receive information from all senses, cuts off ability to be, turns us into the effect our our judgement. Creates toxicity in our bodies. Its really quite a bad trip, and it never works for me. How much has it worked for you? I doubt much at all. How much has it destroyed situations of communion with myself and others? Plenty. Better to choose ease and lightness. 

**Judgement**
This current reality on planet earth is designed by judgements, positive and negative, complex, nuanced, subtle, we have all these judgements that can sap the energy from us in the most dynamic of ways. From birth, relationships withourselves, family, friendships image,  consumer industries tap into judgements of ourselves (the level of collagen in our females lips is bullish); identity groups. The judgement setting is on full crank.  

**Most of our points of view don't belong to us**
If you imagine a radio receiver, that can be tuned to resonate with a certain frequency bandwidth. Imagine all the information it can receive. We are receivers, receiving on many frequency ranges, and we pick up many points of view, since birth. How many of these points of view truly belong to us, and how many of them belong to someone else, but we just bought them us our own? a few, a lot, or more than we can imagine? Everywhere we bought points of view that don't belong to us and are not true for us, will we revoke, recant, rescind, return, destroy and uncreate? 

We're beings with a complex set of thoughts, feeling and emotions overlayed our awareness. How we show up each day is different. How can we deal with ourselves let alone with such dynamics. We can choose lightness or heaviness. A lot of the time we tend to choose heaviness, because we're addicted to judgement, we're addicted to needing to be right and to win over the other. 

**Contraction vs Expansion**
At the core of our energetic bodies, we are essentially wiggly worms. There are two master functions, contraction or expansion. If you poke a worm, it curls into a ball and contracts itself toward a center point, with arrows pointing inwards, trying to hide from the world, and separate itself from the reality it sees as danger. When a worm is out of harms way, it expands outward, arrows pointing out, it goes into the world. We can choose to be expansive in our life or contracted. We can choose the way we want to react to stimulis. We can choose how to judge the stimulus or not. If a stimulus is a legitimate threat then it is better to be aware, then to be the effect of being stuck in the feeling of fear.

**Distractor implants**
Everything that limits us and blocks us from our full spectrum of awareness, capacity and potency is a distraction. We have these implants over our awareness, that block us from choice, keep us in a contracted state. of distraction that are rigidities, solidities, that keep us in reaction between us and the external world. Blame, shame, regret, guilt, anger, hate, rage, fury, doubt... A dynamic web of implants, fuse join, and make us a slave to situations and put us in a pattern of behaviour. 

**Projections, expectations, separations, judgements and rejections.**

All projections, expectations, separations, judgements and rejections, are special kinds distractor implants, that distract us forming a rigid layer over total awareness and total communion with being. 

**How can we be better?**
The only way we can get to be a better group coherence, is to work on ourselves first, be the energetic example we want to us to see. 

Functioning from a doomed conclusion, or an invented reality of how great we are doing, is a distraction from the dynamic of changing whats in front of us. 

**Become aware of distractor implants is the only way to change it.**
Its like being nose blind, if you are not aware you smell then you won't be able to change it. 

**Rather than blame, inspire**
If there is something that you think can be done better or someone else can be better, be the thing you want to see. And inspire a change in others, they can resonate. That's the best way and maybe the only way to change something without force. Telling someone how wrong they are will create separation, and create a dynamic where we have to defend, for and against things, leads to feuds.

**Conclusions vs Questions**
The conventional belief from many is that answers are more valuable than questions. But answers lead to conclusions that limitations by definition. Questions open the doors of perception to the possibilities available to us, which leads to many choice universe. If you take conclusions to its logical conclusion then it lead to a nihilistic reality, of a no-choice universe, where perhaps suicide is the only option. (RIP Robin). Actual questions that open the door, not questions that lead to pre-conceived answers, open the space of possibilities for us to choose.  

**Allowance**
Allowance is the ability to have a space of allowance of ourselves and others without judgment of how good, bad, right or wrong they are being. Its a place where we are not at the effect of their behaviours, attitudes, 

Has my awareness exceeded my allowance?  When we become more aware and our allowance of others doesn't catch up, we can go in to reaction. 

**Contradictions of points of view**
A lot of the time we are both for and against things all the time. It keeps us in a state of heaviness, contraction and dis-ease (disease) and dysfunction, confusion, heaviness and cut off from choice.

What expectations and judgements, of ourselves and others is blocking us from creating the shift we want to see in the world?

We're dealing with ourselves and the points of view and distractions, we have. There are lifetimes of points of view and spells all woven over our awareness. Betterment is a daily practice. Hopefully this is useful to some of you, and it resonates, I enjoyed writing it. 

References:

Access Consciousness - [Blessed Possibilities](https://www.goodreads.com/book/show/32926778-blessed-possibilities)

Wilhelm Reich - [Function of the orgasm](https://www.abebooks.co.uk/Function-Orgasm-Condor-Books-Wilhelm-Reich/30908159010/bd?cm_mmc=ggl-_-UK_Shopp_Tradestandard-_-product_id=UK9780285649705USED-_-keyword=&gclid=Cj0KCQjwpeaYBhDXARIsAEzItbGOPyG0OOLuTUriv9efkdF2aVH5-fKyjzFz3AqerF3SMmz1lhWyLhYaAk3SEALw_wcB)

Wilhelm Reich - [Function of the orgasm](https://www.goodreads.com/book/show/781662.The_Mass_Psychology_of_Fascism)

body:
Wow. Thanks for sharing, glad the prompt was useful, feels like the handbrake was off for that.

Couple of things that stood out to me:

> **Rather than blame, inspire** If there is something that you think can be done better or someone else can be better, be the thing you want to see. And inspire a change in others, they can resonate. That’s the best way and maybe the only way to change something without force. Telling someone how wrong they are will create separation, and create a dynamic where we have to defend, for and against things, leads to feuds.

Completely agree, and I know my own frustrations can come with trying to explain things, that only I can see - but this is the challenge of building collectively... no one will be able to see what you can see, but with enough passion, encouragement and patience, people will follow you, even if you cannot explain the plan or even the next step... in the end, this is trust:

_trust is a bridge from the known to the unknown_.

> **We’re either creating or complaining** There are two main ways of functioning. The empowered way is being the creators, and the disempowered way is being the complainer. The creator never complains because they can choose something different, choosing creates. The complainer doesnt choose because they believe they have no choice but to blame and regret life.

Again reinforces the first quote - if you see a problem, work on it, there's magic there. 

> **Contradictions of points of view** A lot of the time we are both for and against things. It keeps us in a state of paralysed opposition. In this state there is a lot of heaviness, contraction and dis-ease (disease) and dysfunction, confusion, heaviness and cut off from choice. Literally this leads to fascism, the part desire for revolution, and the part desire to not change. 

I have another phrase for this - _analysis paralysis_... in the end, it is better to make some decision, than to not, which is in the end a decision not to act.

Literally this leads to fascism, the part desire for revolution, and the part desire to not change. 

I have another phrase for this - _analysis paralysis_... in the end, it is better to make some decision, than to not, which is in the end a decision not to act. 

This has been my sense with focusing on KSM, that I'd begun to spin my wheels in Edgeware and that the best way of showing the path forward for the chain incubator model that I sense exists, is to start actively developing the distribution channel and frameworks for that.

I've also decided to spend less time on calls, and in the forums and chat, because it was just frustrating me, when really my own energy comes from the creative act of writing and discussing and exploring uncharted territory.  In some weird way, this chaos of opinions and process and organisation, is where I find myself most comfortable. 

Thanks again for sharing your perspective, we can all be better contributors, no-one and nothing is perfect, and never will be, so lets try and enjoy the ride :)
